### Trending products [...] Hi Product Hunt! Daniel here, founder of Datastory.  
  
I've spent my career making data understandable and useful: from animating Hans Rosling's TED Talks at Gapminder to building data platforms for the Red Cross, the UN Statistics Division, Brookings and Sweden's national health registries.  
  
Every project showed me the same thing: organizations were building similar platforms from scratch, at great cost. Communicating data well was still slow, expensive, expert work.  
  
We started Datastory as a non-profit, publishing data journalism and building our own tools because nothing else was fast enough. Over time the tools became the product, now used by public agencies, researchers and newsrooms. [...] ### Top reviewed

### Q: Which data visualization tools offer AI-assisted chart creation and natural language querying?

Basedash and Hex are the clearest picks for AI-assisted charting and natural-language querying.

Basedash: AI-native Autopilot creates charts from plain-English prompts, handles complex or ambiguous questions, and connects across 600+ sources so the agent can reason across datasets.

Hex: AI agents speed dashboard creation and let you upload CSVs/spreadsheets — every cell becomes queryable and usable by the AI features.
